class Flow {

  static void run(bool a, bool b) {
    var l = <int>[1, 2, 3];
    for (var e in l) print('- $e');
    for (var i = 0; i < 3 ; ++i) print('i: $i');
    var i = 0;
    while( i < 3 ) i = i + 1;
    print('while: $i');
    do i = i - 1; while (i > 0);
    print('do: $i');
    if (a) print('x');
    else print('y');

    if (a) print('A');
    else if (b) print('B');
    else print('C');

    if (a) if (b) print('ab');
    else print('a!b');


    for (var e in l) if (e > 2) print('gt2: $e');

    for (var e in l) {
      print('braced: $e');
    }
    if (a) print('guard');

    var elseCount = 1;
    print('elseCount: $elseCount');
  }

}
